title: RBI to conduct Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on September 15, 2026
text: RBI to conduct Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on September 15, 2026. On a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions, it has been decided to conduct a Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, as under: Sl. No. Notified Amount (₹ crore) Tenor (day) Window Timing Date of Reversal 1 5,00,000 1 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM September 16, 2026 (Wednesday) 2. The operational guidelines for the auction as given in the Reserve Bank’s Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020 will remain the same. Ajit Prasad            Deputy General Manager (Communications)     Press Release: 2026-2027/1108
